resource: Direct Container(parent = corpse) entries of one creature's corpse ItemInstance
allocation_impact: The composing caller's whole-plan preflight checks the death's full accepted loot-plan entry count against this ceiling before any entry (corpse included) is frozen; the database also caps one corpse parent at 16 entries at commit under a corpse-row lock taken before counting (mirrors GAMEITEM01-CONTAINER-ENTRIES-MAX's backpack ceiling), so a concurrent race at the ceiling still admits at most 16.
boundary_tests: max=16: the 16th loot entry is placed in the corpse's container
max+1=17: the 17th loot entry is refused by the database, leaving exactly 16 live entries
notes: D131, decision §4.2: equal by construction to the already-accepted COMBAT01-LOOT-PLAN-ITEMS/COMBAT01-ITEMS-PER-CORPSE (both 16); the two must never diverge. Registered by OTV2-20260929-d3-1-corpse-migration.
